REDUPLICATOR$PARENS$ASSIGNMENTS	aab	aabaab
REDUPLICATOR$PARENS$ASSIGNMENTS	thechicken	thechickenthechicken
REDUPLICATOR$PARENS$ASSIGNMENTS	oogabooga#	oogabooga#oogabooga#
## And now for something a bit more interesting, initial C*V reduplication a la
##
## Inkelas, Sharon and Zoll, Cheryl, 2005, Reduplication: Doubling in
## Morphology. Cambridge University Press
##
## whereby reduplication is modeled as a full copy, followed by reduction on the
## parts.
PARTIAL_REDUPLICATION$PARENS$ASSIGNMENTS	tamata	tatamata
PARTIAL_REDUPLICATION$PARENS$ASSIGNMENTS	kidongo	kikidongo
PARTIAL_REDUPLICATION$PARENS$ASSIGNMENTS	amutu	aamutu
PARTIAL_REDUPLICATION$PARENS$ASSIGNMENTS	krispikrim	krikrispikrim
PARTIAL_REDUPLICATION$PARENS$ASSIGNMENTS	wugabuga	wuwugabuga
## Infixing reduplication examples
INFIXING_REDUPLICATION$PARENS$ASSIGNMENTS	tamata	tamamata
INFIXING_REDUPLICATION$PARENS$ASSIGNMENTS	kidongo	kididongo
INFIXING_REDUPLICATION$PARENS$ASSIGNMENTS	donut	dononut
## Deduplication examples
DEDUPLICATOR$PARENS$ASSIGNMENTS	orangorang	orang2
DEDUPLICATOR$PARENS$ASSIGNMENTS	googoo	goo2
DEDUPLICATOR$PARENS$ASSIGNMENTS	meme	me2
